news.casting_brief: NASA astrophysics director Shawn Domagal-Goldman; ambitious startup engineers at a 2020 founded space firm; mission team racing a deadline to save a dying observatory.
news.script_brief: NASA gives three companies under a year to save a $500M astronomy satellite falling toward Earth. A young startup wins with a daring plan: chase the craft, grab it with robotic arms, and boost its orbit. Tension: brutal deadline, tight budget, untested feat. Hooks: the pitch, the contract, the launch, the catch.
news.news_close_brief: With the contract signed and the clock running, the question remains whether a small spacecraft can reach Swift, latch on, and lift it to safety before time runs out.
